name: nano-claude-code-plugins
description: Plugins for Claude Code that put cost and delegation discipline under explicit control

plugins.name: boom
plugins.description: Cost-first delegation control: L0-L4 task budgets, role-to-model routing, a Fable critical-worker gate, bounded worker agents, specialist PR review agents with a /boom:review skill, parallel codebase research with a /boom:codebase-question skill, and a PreToolUse hook that denies model inheritance on Agent, Workflow, and SendMessage dispatches
